name: rewrite-pad
desc: Free, open-source text rewriting workbench for Windows — shorten, formalize, simplify with a local LLM. 100 MB portable, offline, MIT.
features: ✅ **Action buttons** — shorten, formalize, simplify, expand and fix grammar run against any local llama.cpp server
✅ **Diff review** — changes shown as inline diffs; accept per hunk instead of trusting a full overwrite
✅ **Tone presets** — professional, friendly and plain-English modes saved with their own instructions
✅ **Clipboard round trip** — hotkey takes the selection, rewrites it and puts the result back
✅ **Style memory** — a short rules box reminds the model of your conventions every run
✅ **Project history** — every rewrite kept with before and after, searchable
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — runtime bundled, model runs locally, offline, MIT with SHA-256 releases
compare: | Price | **Free, MIT** | Paid premium | Free tier | Free tiers |
| Text stays local | **Yes** | Upload | Upload | Partial
| Arbitrary rewrite actions | **Yes** | Limited | Chatty | No
| Per-hunk diff accept | **Yes** | No | No | Partial
| Portable, no install | **Yes, 100 MB** | Extension | Browser | Extension
faqQ: offline paraphrasing tool for Windows that does not upload my text?
faqA: Web paraphrasers upload whatever you paste and gate the good modes behind a subscription. rewrite-pad talks to a local LLM server, shows rewrites as reviewable diffs and keeps every draft in local history. It is a 100 MB portable exe, MIT, and works with the network unplugged.
s1: Dark pad (#121418, blue #3B82F6): original text left pane, rewritten right pane with green and red inline diffs, accept all and keep original buttons beneath.
s2: Tone shelf: five preset cards with descriptions, custom rules box expanded showing terminology list, model connection chip reading localhost ready.
s3: History list: twenty rewrites with timestamps and reading-time deltas, search field, reopen in compare action on the hovered row.
